aciklama.belge: Internal wiki, client and project documents, meeting notes. Checkbox to-dos, version history, read-only sharing with the client, PDF and Markdown.
aciklama.strateji: SWOT, Business Model Canvas, Lean Canvas, PESTLE, Porter's Five Forces, McKinsey 7S, Blue Ocean and Ikigai templates; AI draft, sharing and PDF.
aciklama.musteriBelge: Documents your agency shared with you and (if your module is on) your own documents, notes and to-dos.
aciklama.musteriStrateji: Strategy work your agency shared and (if your module is on) your own SWOT, business model and other templates.

secin.belge: Pick a document on the left to read it, or create a new one.
secin.strateji: Pick a strategy work on the left, or start with a new template.

bos.belge: No documents yet. Create your first wiki page or meeting note.
bos.strateji: No strategy work yet. Choose a template to start.
bos.musteri: No documents have been shared with you yet.

alanlar.isletme: Describe the business briefly (the AI draft uses this)
alanlar.isletmeIpucu: What do you sell, to whom, where? You may add figures you know; the AI does not invent numbers.
alanlar.kutuIpucu: Write each item on its own line
alanlar.sabit: Pin to the top of the list

arac.ipucu: Markdown: ## heading, **bold**, - item, - [ ] to-do (assign with @email), | table |. HTML is not allowed. Shortcut: Ctrl+S saves.

ai.talimatIpucu: E.g. write a short guide explaining our delivery process to clients
ai.taslakHazir: Draft ready: suggestions are shown under the boxes. Apply them box by box or all at once.
ai.kapali: AI is not configured on this site; the AI buttons are off. They turn on once an admin adds a key.
ai.secimNot: If you select text, summarize and proofread apply to the selection only; otherwise the whole document is used.
ai.taslakNot: Describe the business first. The draft is only a suggestion; no invented figures, nothing is saved until you approve.

surum.secin: Pick a version on the left to preview it.
surum.geriYukleOnay: Restore version {{sayi}}? The current state also stays in the history.

yapilacak.aciklama: Unchecked checkboxes in documents. Assign an item to someone by writing @email in it.
yapilacak.bos: No open items assigned to you.
yapilacak.projeGerekli: The document must be linked to a project to create a task.

swot.aciklama: Strengths and weaknesses, opportunities and threats (2×2).

is_modeli.aciklama: The business model in nine boxes: partners, activities, value proposition, customers, revenue and costs.

lean.aciklama: For startups: problem, solution, metrics, unique value proposition and unfair advantage.

pestle.aciklama: External environment: political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental factors.

porter.aciklama: Competitive pressure in the industry: new entrants, suppliers, buyers, substitutes and rivalry.

mckinsey_7s.aciklama: Alignment of seven elements: strategy, structure, systems, shared values, style, staff, skills.

mavi_okyanus.aciklama: For uncontested markets: what will you eliminate and reduce, raise and create?

ikigai.aciklama: Where what you love, what you are good at, what the world needs and what pays meet.

kutu.para_kazandiran: What you can be paid for
